Class WhoObservations

java.lang.Object
org.jwcarman.who.core.observation.WhoObservations
public final class WhoObservations extends Object
Runs who's own work inside a Micrometer Observation tagged with its outcome, so that a failing observation handler never changes who's answer.

Micrometer calls handlers on the observed thread and does not catch what they throw. who catches it here: a handler failure is logged at WARN (exception class only) and the work's result, or the work's own exception, is what the caller gets.

Internal to who. This class is public only so that who's own modules can share it. It is not part of who's supported API and may change or disappear in any release, including a patch release; applications observe who through the observation names who documents, not through this class.

      public static <T> T observe(io.micrometer.observation.ObservationRegistry registry, String name, String contextualName, Supplier<T> work, Function<? super T, String> outcome)
      Runs work inside an observation named name, tagged "outcome" with the value outcome gives for the result, or "error" when work throws.
      Type Parameters:
      T - the work's result type
      Parameters:
      registry - where the observation is recorded; ObservationRegistry.NOOP records nothing
      name - the observation's name
      contextualName - the observation's contextual name, used for spans
